rows.label: tlk79000006_01_msg0001
rows.name:
I can faintly sense that His Majesty
is troubled.

rows.label: tlk79000006_01_msg0002
rows.name:
This incident must be weighing
heavily on him.

rows.label: tlk79000006_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Even if he doesn't put it into words,
I can tell because I stay by his side.
